title: SlateSync Canvas Document
description: Locked .slatesync document.json body (overview §4.3). All document keys snake_case.

groups.description: Round-9 issue 05: OPTIONAL lock-group map, group_id -> [node_id, ...]. A locked group behaves as ONE object in the selector until unlocked. Omitted when empty so pre-round-9 documents round-trip byte-identically. NodeStyle is frozen, so a per-node flag cannot express this and the relation is document-level anyway (a node belongs to at most one group).

pages.description: Round-13 issue 04: OPTIONAL ordered page list of a BOOK (artboard.preset == 'BOOK'). Omitted (never empty-and-present) for a non-book document so it round-trips byte-identically. Elements address their page through Element.page_id; an element with no page_id belongs to the FIRST page, which is what every pre-round-13 document means.

Artboard.description: Page frame in 300-DPI world units; top-left origin (0,0) -> (w,h); INFINITE keeps width/height null.

width.description: A5 1748.0 | A4 2480.0 | LETTER 2550.0 | BOOK = the selected page size (default A4 2480.0) | IMAGE = the source image's exact pixel width (round-13 gallery) | null if INFINITE

height.description: A5 2480.0 | A4 3508.0 | LETTER 3300.0 | BOOK = the selected page size (default A4 3508.0) | IMAGE = the source image's exact pixel height (round-13 gallery) | null if INFINITE

background_spacing.description: World-unit gap between rules (RULED) or side length of one cell (SQUARE_GRID); ignored for BLANK. Default 32.0 (round-9: replaces DOT_GRID/ISO_GRID, which load as BLANK)

ContentBounds.description: Union of all element bboxes recomputed after every mutation; empty document => all zeros (owners: PC Doc 09, Dart Docs 22+23).

NodeStyle.description: Per-element paint settings (mirror: template §4 NodeStyle / Dart NodeStyleModel).

fill.description: Round-9 issue 04: OPTIONAL interior colour set by the fill tool. Omitted (never null) when the node has no fill, so pre-round-9 documents round-trip byte-identically. stroke_width == 0 remains the legacy spelling of 'solid in color'.

NodeGeometry.description: Point list plus kind-specific fields; unused fields are null (mirror: template §4 NodeGeometry / Dart NodeGeometryModel).

pts.description: world-space points/Bézier controls; empty for IMAGE elements

shape_type.description: set for SHAPE/GRAPH_AXES, else null; PATH = closed polygon filled when stroke_width == 0 (round-9 region fill / rotated shapes), TABLE = grid described by graph_config (round-9), TEXT = text box whose content lives in graph_config (round-12)

rows.description: TABLE body rows, excluding the header row

header_row.description: TABLE: first row is a header band

header_col.description: TABLE: first column is a header band

text.description: TEXT: the string to draw (newlines are hard breaks)

font_size.description: TEXT: font size in world units, clamped to 6..400 by every renderer

align.description: TEXT: horizontal alignment inside the node bbox

asset_ref.description: ZIP entry path of the attached file, e.g. assets/img_9921.png

Element.description: One vector node (overview §4.3); kind selects how geometry is interpreted.

page_id.description: Round-13 issue 04: OPTIONAL page address inside a BOOK. Absent/null means the FIRST page, so every pre-round-13 document (and every page-1 element of a book) keeps its frozen key list. One element list serves every page: 'which page am I on' is a filter, never a second storage path.

BookPage.description: Round-13 issue 04: one entry of a BOOK's ordered `pages` list. `index` is the 0-based reading position and MUST be dense (0..n-1) — every writer reindexes after a mutation, so a reordered list can never carry stale positions.

page_id.description: uuid-v4 (or any non-empty stable token); the value Element.page_id refers to. '__cover__' is reserved for the cover image and is never a real page.

index.description: 0-based reading position; dense after every mutation

title.description: page label shown in the page strip

BOOK.description: Round 13: bounded multi-page book. The dims are the DEFAULT page size (A4); a book's real page size is the artboard width/height chosen at creation (A4 / A5 / LETTER only — an infinite book is deliberately unrepresentable).

x_upgrade_rule: ALLOW = (target == "INFINITE") OR (content_bounds.min_x >= 0 AND content_bounds.min_y >= 0 AND content_bounds.max_x <= target.width AND content_bounds.max_y <= target.height)
x_content_bounds_rule: union of element bboxes after every mutation; empty document => {min_x:0,min_y:0,max_x:0,max_y:0}
